service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , CONT_FORM_NO , CONT_TYPE , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , CONT_FORM_NAME , CONT_FORM_DESC , STATUS , USE_FLAG , CATEGORY , CONT_METHOD , USE_FROM , USE_TO , SIGNER_CODE FROM SCFGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND CONT_FORM_NO = ${CONT_NO} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

UPDATE SCFGL SET CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE} , CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME} , CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} , STATUS = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${STATUS} , STATUS) , CONT_FORM_NAME = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONT_FORM_NAME}, CONT_FORM_NAME) , USE_FROM = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${USE_FROM} , USE_FROM) , USE_TO = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${USE_TO} , USE_TO) , CATEGORY = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CATEGORY} , CATEGORY) , CONT_TYPE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONT_TYPE}, CONT_TYPE) , CONT_FORM_DESC = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONT_FORM_DESC}, CONT_FORM_DESC) , CONT_METHOD = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONT_METHOD} , CONT_METHOD) , SIGNER_CODE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGNER_CODE} , SIGNER_CODE) , DEL_FLAG = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${DEL_FLAG} , DEL_FLAG) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND CONT_FORM_NO = ${CONT_NO}
